data.cultural_impact: The name Suaidan holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic world, particularly in the Arabic language. It is derived from the Arabic root "sa'ada", which means "happiness" or "peace", and the suffix "an" which signifies an infinitive verb. The name Suaidan is often given as a reminder of its fundamental meaning - one who provides help, support and companionship. This name encapsulates the spirit of unity, kindness and stability that are valued traits in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Suaidan holds profound significance in connoting the idea of being a source of comfort, solace and strength in times of need. It reminds us of the divine attribute of Allah (swt) as the Help and Supporter (Al-Matur and Al-Mutmain) of His creation. This name reflects the Islamic ethos that emphasizes caring for one's fellow human beings and serving as a beacon of support for those in need, emulating the compassionate and merciful nature of Allah (swt).

historical_references.reference: Al-Bakri's 'The Book of the Wonders of the World'. Suaidan mentioned as a city and kingdom in the Maghreb region.
